resources.string: After you select a sports event in prettTV, find its two teams and start time in RBTV and open the matching game. Stops before selecting a server. Reads and operates RBTV only during this request, for up to 30 seconds. It does not intercept Home or operate other apps.
Open TV settings from any app

When enabled, releasing the remote Settings button opens TV settings from any app. On TCL TVs, this also handles the remote button reported as Notification. Other buttons, including Home, pass through. The helper receives key events but does not log them, read screen content or change settings. Turn it off here to restore the TV default button behavior.
Make the Home button open Rivi

When on, pressing Home opens Rivi instead of the Google TV home screen. Nothing on the projector is disabled or removed. It only sees the Home key and when the Google TV home screen appears; it cannot read screen content. Turn it off here to get the Google TV home screen back.
Home button: opens Google TV. Turn on \"Rivi Home button\" under Accessibility.
